models.savedRevision: {{name}} saved as a new revision; accepted runs are not affected
models.title: Model configurations
models.description: How to call a model: protocol, endpoint, model ID and request parameters. Keys can only be bound as team credentials, never written into parameters or the endpoint. Changes create a new revision; accepted runs keep the revision they were accepted with.
models.disabledToast: Disabled: new runs can no longer select it
models.endpointHint: http/https, without keys or query parameters

upstream.newerThanTested: Newer than the version Maestro tested
upstream.title: Upstream versions
upstream.lookupFailed: Could not look up upstream versions ({{error}}). You can enter an exact version directly.
upstream.testedNote: This Maestro version passed real-model tests with it
upstream.untested: {{version}} has not been tested with this Maestro: upstream may have changed parameters or log formats. Try a small run after publishing.

harness.published: Harness version published; its content cannot change, publish a new version to change it
harness.title: Harness versions
harness.description: A Harness is the program that drives a model through a task. Each version is fixed once published; the executor implements it with an adapter and declares which model protocols it can call.
harness.noAdapters: The executor has no Harness adapters available yet, so nothing can be published.
harness.versionHint: The name of this Harness version in Maestro
harness.upstreamHint: The {{package}} version actually installed in the container; must be an exact version and cannot change after publishing
harness.modelParams: Model configuration parameters it can pass: {{list}}

setting.service_cpus_default: CPUs for helper services without declared resources (default)
setting.service_memory_mb_default: Memory for helper services without declared resources, MiB (default)
setting.pat_default_run_limit: Runs an access token can submit (default)
setting.pat_max_run_limit: Runs an access token can submit (max)
setting.login_attempts_per_minute: Failed logins allowed per account and address per minute

policy.saved: Saved as a new revision; applies to new submissions, accepted runs are unchanged
policy.title: Team policy
policy.description: Team defaults and hard limits. Each save creates a new revision that only affects later submissions; configurations over a limit are rejected, never silently reduced. Machine and disk limits are in the deployment configuration config.toml.

setupNetwork.saved: Saved as revision {{revision}}; preparations and executions that start from now on use it
setupNetwork.title: Setup network
setupNetwork.description: The network this host uses to install software: proxy and package mirrors for image builds, Harness installation and attachment scripts. Each save creates a new revision that preparations and executions starting afterwards use immediately, including queued runs; the Agent and verification phases never use it. It is not part of the run configuration and every team member can see it, so never enter credentials here.
setupNetwork.proxyHint: An address containers can reach, not 127.0.0.1; leave empty for no proxy. Used for image builds, Harness installation and attachment scripts
setupNetwork.envHint: Environment variables passed to Harness installation and attachment scripts, usually to set package mirrors, e.g. npm_config_registry, NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR, PIP_INDEX_URL. Not used for image builds. The proxy can only be set in the field above; names starting with MAESTRO_ are reserved for the platform, and credential-like names (containing token, key, auth, etc.) are rejected.
setupNetwork.timeoutHint: Leave empty for the Harness's own default (usually 360 seconds); attachments add their install time
setupNetwork.notePlaceholder: e.g. switch to npmmirror, nodejs.org often drops through the proxy

deployment.title: Deployment configuration (read-only)
deployment.description: From /etc/maestro/config.toml and the service environment on the host; change them on the host and restart the service. Image pulls use the Docker daemon's own proxy and mirrors, which maestroctl check reports.
deployment.serviceProxyNote: (used for Hub downloads, image registry tokens and Terminus model requests)
deployment.retired: {{keys}} in config.toml are no longer used and will be ignored; enter them again in "Setup network" above and remove them from the file.
